evidence_sentence: It checks if the data is within bounds and allocates memory for the output buffer if necessary.
rationale: Both versions decode the length, check the input range, decrypt, validate the header version and magic value, advance the input pointer, and return the output length or an error. However, only the fixed implementation accepts an output-buffer pointer-to-pointer and allocates a buffer when no output buffer exists. The vulnerable implementation receives an output buffer directly and has no allocation path.
rewritten_docstring: The function first decodes the length of the data to be decrypted and checks whether the data is within bounds. It then performs the decryption and verifies the integrity of the decrypted data by checking its version and magic number. Finally, it updates the input pointer and returns the size of the decrypted data or an error code if any checks fail.
